inherited_release_gate.note: All prior extraction/rendering/audio/route/camera/mobile/code-lineage, native-builder and dev23 workspace gates are inherited. Dev24 adds a shareable delta package layer, expands retail round-trip evidence, and optimizes the common COL inverse path without modifying the sealed dev23 release.

dev24_real_corpus_roundtrip.scope: user-supplied retail Xbox 360 external corpus; proprietary inputs not bundled
dev24_real_corpus_roundtrip.boundary: No-edit byte identity proves lossless reconstruction on the tested retail corpus; arbitrary modified-asset runtime acceptance remains a separate gate.

fresh_package.note: Candidate was extracted fresh, verified against RELEASE_MANIFEST with no unlisted files, audited before executing package code, and passed 69/69 selftests. Final package is rebuilt deterministically after recording these candidate results and revalidated separately.

limitations: PS3 NPDRM/SDAT re-encryption is not implemented; mod-build emits verified decompressed BBX for SDAT-backed resources.
GMX native editing remains template-preserving and fixed-layout; arbitrary topology/count/chunk-graph synthesis is not claimed.
Retail byte-identical no-op rebuilds do not by themselves prove runtime acceptance of arbitrary modifications.
V1 mod packages reject/require explicit resolution for conflicting changes rather than semantically merging multiple mods.
Length-changing whole-archive binary deltas above the conservative bounded SequenceMatcher limit are rejected; stage the changed inner resource where possible.
Xbox XACT/XMA2 and PS3 SBlk/VAG/989SND banks decode to common audio but do not yet have native replacement-bank builders.
Xenos shader containers expose bounded raw microcode and metadata; ISA disassembly/translation/compilation remains unresolved.
